answer_1.quote: Semantic parsing is one of the central tasks for natural language understanding (NLU). It is defined as the task of generating meaning representations from natural language utterances.

answer_2.quote: Agarwal et al. ( ) pointed out the shortcomings of existing evaluation metrics like BLEU score , Exact Match accuracy and Template accuracy  in the context of natural language to Bash generation and proposed a new scoring mechanism for the NLC2CMD competition.
